data.narrative:
Atmos Space Cargo is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company that has raised €30M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 5 public-traded space companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 3 private peers at Series B and adjacent stages: Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B), Aalyria ($1.3B), and Starcloud ($1.1B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x multiplier to the €30M raised proxy, implying €60M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables yields a €1.3B median valuation, with a range of €1.1B to €2.0B. Public-comp anchoring using a 24.6x P/S median across the five public tickers cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue for the target.

The triangulated range spans €51M to €1.5B, with a median of €680M across the two applicable methods. This wide spread reflects the inherent dispersion between the stage-progression method (conservative, capital-based) and peer multiples (market-based, reflecting sector momentum). Key uncertainties include whether Atmos's operational milestones and technical differentiation align it toward the upper peer range or whether near-term capital intensity and execution risk justify a discount closer to the stage-progression floor. Additional disclosure of revenue guidance or customer commitments would narrow this band substantially.
